Bill.BriefDescription: Prohibiting restrictions on the location of manufactured homes based exclusively on age and dimensions.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to prohibiting certain restrictions on the locationof manufactured homes; adding a new section to chapter 35.21 RCW;adding a new section to chapter 35A.21 RCW; and adding a new section tochapter 36.01 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 35.21 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A city or town may not enact any statute or ordinance that has theeffect, directly or indirectly, of restricting the location ofmanufactured homes in manufactured housing communities, as defined inRCW 59.20.030, based exclusively on the age or dimensions of themanufactured home.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 35A.21 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A code city may not enact any statute or ordinance that has theeffect, directly or indirectly, of restricting the location ofmanufactured homes in manufactured housing communities, as defined in p. 1 SB 6511RCW 59.20.030, based exclusively on the age or dimensions of themanufactured home.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 36.01 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A county may not enact any statute or ordinance that has theeffect, directly or indirectly, of restricting the location ofmanufactured homes in manufactured housing communities, as defined inRCW 59.20.030, based exclusively on the age or dimensions of themanufactured home.
